objects.taxonomy_description: 长颈鹿属于偶蹄目长颈鹿科，是现存最高的陆生哺乳动物，以其极长的颈部和独特的骨皮角为显著特征。

diagnostic_checkpoints.颈部: 拥有极度延长的颈部，长度显著超过身体其他部分，用于高处取食。
diagnostic_checkpoints.头部: 头顶具有一对或多对被皮肤和毛发覆盖的骨质突起（骨皮角），而非分叉的骨质鹿角或中空牛角。
diagnostic_checkpoints.四肢: 四肢修长且比例均匀，前肢通常略长于后肢，支撑高大的身躯。
diagnostic_checkpoints.体态: 整体轮廓呈现明显的前高后低倾斜姿态，肩部隆起高于臀部。

objects.taxonomy_description: Equine mammal measuring 140-170 cm at withers with athletic build. Coat uniform brownish-orange to light chestnut coloration with no black points. Mane and tail same color as body or lighter (flaxen). Head elongated with large expressive eyes and mobile ears. Neck arched and muscular. Body deep-chested with strong back. Legs long and slender with single hoof per foot. Tail long with flowing hair. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse body hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Color variant of horse distinguished by reddish-brown coat.

Head_and_Face: Elongated head with large expressive eyes and mobile ears.
Body_and_Plumage: Athletic build with tall, lean proportions at the withers.
Uniform brownish-orange to light chestnut coat coloration with no black points.
Mane and tail same color as body or lighter (flaxen).
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Long slender legs with single hoof per foot.

objects.taxonomy_description: Domestic swine measuring 90-180 cm body length weighing 50-350 kg. Body stocky and barrel-shaped with sparse coarse bristles over pink, black, or spotted skin. Head large with elongated snout ending in cartilaginous disk for rooting. Eyes small. Ears large and floppy or erect depending on breed. Legs short and stout with cloven hooves. Tail short and curly. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Omnivorous with highly developed olfactory sense.

Head_and_Face: Large head with elongated snout ending in cartilaginous disk for rooting.
Large floppy or erect ears depending on breed.
Body_and_Plumage: Stocky barrel-shaped body with variable size ranging from moderate to impressively massive.
Sparse coarse bristles over pink, black, or spotted skin.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Short stout legs with cloven hooves.
